newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: "Green shoe" exercised in Telecel float.
newsitem.headline: "Green shoe" exercised in Telecel float.

text.p: A "green shoe" representing 763,650 shares of Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel was exercised in the flotation of a stake in the company, said a source in Banco Essi, one of the global coordinators of the operation.
"Yesterday a green shoe of 763,650 Telecel shares was exercised," the source told Reuters.
Under a "green shoe", additional shares may be allocated to institutional investors if demand is very heavy.
The sale on Monday of a 35.6 percent stake in Telecel, one of the biggest flotations in Portuguese history, was heavily oversubscribed and netted 60.8 billion escudos.
The price fixed in the flotation of Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais, one of two mobile phone operators in Portugal, was 7,950 escudos per share.
Telecel shares stood unchanged at 9,530 escudos on Lisbon bourse at 1107 GMT.
